text: For purposes of this Article contingent capital is stipulated to be the predefined conversion of a certain percentage of a financial institution's debt securities into equity securities.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455

isBasedOn.name: Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance

abstract: For purposes of this Article, contingent capi- tal is the predefined conversion of a certain percentage of finan- cial institutions' debt securities into equity securities.
